title: Selected Work
subtitle: AI product shipped in production · prototype-vs-production discipline · B2C consumer-scale KPI history — selected for Lounge by Zalando

application.role: Engineering Manager — AI Innovation // Lounge by Zalando (all genders)
application.pursuit_framing: PATH 2 — complementary "AI Product Design counterpart to the AI Innovation EM" pitch with explicit disqualification of the Engineering-Manager profile in paragraph 1 of the cover letter
application.positioning: AI product shipped in production (design/product side) · Prototype-vs-production discipline · B2C consumer-scale KPI history · Berlin + German + English · Responsible AI by design (GDPR+)
application.same_archetype_as: xentral (founder-startup variant); zalando is the corporate-scale-up variant of the same "hard-engineering role under leadership title" pattern

selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Primary AI-agent-in-production anchor. Direct phrasal match for the JD's 'LLM-powered experiences,' 'assistant frameworks,' and 'responsible AI by design' vocabulary — from the design/product side, honestly scoped. Handbook-as-context (not vector-store RAG), escalation-as-first-class-output, human-keeps-the-send-decision. Carries the crystallised AI opinion required for the cover letter ('move the blank-page part, don't touch the judgment') and gives the recruiter a concrete production-AI-artifact to point to. In-depth format because the executive variant strips the design decisions that make this case study credible under Zalando's mature engineering culture.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: The single strongest B2C measurable-outcome KPI story in the portfolio — 70% funeral coordination-time reduction, 90% booking acceptance rate, 20+ cemeteries. Sentence-for-sentence maps onto the JD's 'measurable business outcomes (conversion / CSAT / productivity / cost)' outcome frame. Also carries the GDPR+ regulated-context signal for the JD's 'responsible AI by design + privacy/safety/compliance' vocabulary (via the shipped-in-production AI alt-text at the same company). Reframed the scope from 'funeral-booking feature' to 'booking capability deeply integrated into the platform' — strategic-influence proof for the AI-Innovation-team stakeholder-alignment expectation. In-depth format because the scope-reframe + measurable-impact + multi-stakeholder + regulated-context story compresses badly.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: The concrete proof story for the JD's 'AI product engineering mindset — prototype vs production discipline' must-have. Designs in Figma → prototypes in real code against real Bibel TV APIs with real videos and real metadata; engineering consumes ~70% of the prototype code directly; design-to-prototype cycle 3–5 days → 1 day. The Android-gradient iteration is the referenceable story for interview and cover-letter paragraph 2. In-depth because the executive variant loses the concrete-proof anchor. Honestly framed at the design-engineering-bridge layer — NOT Staff/Principal-Engineer backend commits, NOT distributed-systems ownership.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Second AI-product proof point + crystallises the 'show output, allow users to edit' user-agency principle the cover letter reuses. Founder-stealth engagement (CEO + technical co-founder before the product team) demonstrates close-to-engineering working style. B2B/SME context is adjacent (not identical) to Zalando/Lounge's B2C fashion — do NOT over-index on the SME angle for this application (that was Xentral's headline). Browseable/executive because ninox is the secondary AI story here; featured slots go to Bibel TV + ChurchDesk which map more cleanly to Zalando's B2C consumer-scale KPI outcome frame.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: The closest architectural-infrastructure adjacency in the portfolio, honestly framed at design-system-tooling scope. Signals 'Tobias thinks in APIs / architectures / three-tier hierarchies' without overclaiming distributed systems. Available for a Zalando engineer-interviewer who wants to see infrastructure-shaped thinking; kept out of Featured because the JD screens for distributed-systems-at-flash-sales-throughput, and surfacing this as a Featured anchor could be mistaken for that claim. Executive format keeps it complementary to the AI-product-anchor trio above.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — the closest apparel-vertical adjacency Tobias has (print-on-demand apparel, hundreds-of-thousands of consumers) and the cleanest research-to-executive-strategy-shift story. Kept in the earlier-career block on the CV. Hidden here because the AI-product cluster is the differentiator, and Spreadshirt (2014–2016) surfaces the older B2C KPI arc via ?all for readers going deep on consumer-scale credibility. Note: it is NOT fashion-native; the CV frames it as 'print-on-demand apparel e-commerce' — do NOT surface as 'fashion e-commerce' in the portfolio subtitle.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Hidden — strong design-leadership story (performance calls, hiring/firing, SLT membership, coaching the design lead). Hidden because Zalando's JD screens explicitly for management of engineers on the EM ladder, and surfacing design-team org-building as Featured could invite the literal-manage-engineers question the path-2 pitch already concedes as a gap. Available via ?all for readers who want to verify people-leadership depth.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — 5-year director tenure + cross-Atlantic (Berlin ↔ NYC) + regulated-enterprise customer base is real credibility depth, but the confidential flag limits screenshot surface and the case study frames at the data-visualisation layer, not the AI-product layer. Kept for readers going deep via ?all; the CV references Datameer's tenure separately as the scale anchor.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — B2C streaming-media growth-and-competitive-strategy case study is well-crafted but doesn't add to the AI-product-differentiator cluster for Zalando specifically. Kept for ?all readers.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — craft-depth proof (OKLCH, k-means) but narrow fit for an AI-Innovation-EM screen; risks pulling the recruiter's attention away from the AI-product-practice anchors.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantially overlaps bibeltv-agentic-engineering AND status=in-progress with known AI-slop issues flagged at the n8n review. Avoid surfacing two near-duplicate stories in the Zalando view, and avoid surfacing a story that has not passed the writing quality gate.

gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.engineering_manager_career_track: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 1 (NO MATCH — Structural): the path-2 pitch acknowledges plainly in cover-letter paragraph 1 that Tobias has led designers and writers, not engineers on the EM ladder. NO new case study fabricated to paper over this. Truthfulness gates 13/14/15 forbid softening.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.distributed_systems_at_scale: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 2 (NO MATCH — Hard): bibeltv-design-system-api is the closest real adjacency (Git + Style Dictionary + three-tier tokens + Android live + Figma synced + iOS/web endpoints). Honestly framed at design-system-tooling scope, NOT distributed-systems at flash-sales throughput. No additional case study fabricated.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.jvm_kotlin_scala_python_stack_plus_slo_o: Per cv-tailoring-brief Gap 3 (NO MATCH — Hard): the code Tobias writes is HTML/CSS/JS + SwiftUI + AI-assisted Kotlin/Swift/TypeScript prototype code consumed by engineering. Not daily JVM production, not backend Python, no SLO ownership, no on-call rotation. Cover letter names plainly. NO case study fabricated.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.vector_store_rag_architecture: Per verification-log Pillar A: CS Copilot is a managed-platform SKILL using handbook-as-flat-context, NOT vector-store RAG. bibeltv-support-agent is honestly framed. No 'RAG system' or 'vector-store architecture' claim will be surfaced in the portfolio subtitle or any Featured case study framing.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.custom_agent_orchestration_code: Per verification log: Tobias did NOT personally write LLM-orchestration code for the CS Copilot SKILL or the Ninox vibe-coding engine. Both case studies frame the design/product-scoping work honestly. 'AI fundraising pipeline currently building' at Bibel TV is referenced only in the cv-tailoring brief as in-build status — no separate case study, no shipped/deployed framing, no metrics.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.fashion_flash_sales_native_domain: Spreadshirt is print-on-demand apparel; HairDirect is US retail; neither is fashion-flash-sales native. Portfolio subtitle deliberately says 'B2C consumer-scale KPI history' not 'fashion e-commerce.' No new case study fabricated for a domain Tobias hasn't worked in.
